units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:3">Shebi. II, 3</cite> <he>כפִיסּוּלָהּ של חמישית</he> the trimming as it is done in the fifth year, contrad. to <cite ref="G00421"><he>זֵירוּד</he></cite>.

Ib. כל זמן … רשאי אני בפִסּוּלוֹ as long as I am permitted to do what is necessary to cultivate the tree, I am also permitted to trim it; Y. ib. 33ᵈ אני רשאי בפיסולו עד העצרת ‘I am permitted to trim it’, that means up to the festival of Shabuoth.—Pl. פִּיסּוּלִים, פִּיסּוּלִין, פִּסּ׳ chiselled (millstones).
